characters.name: Noah
clues: I built a giant boat even though it had never rained.
Animals came to me two by two.
I sent out a dove to look for dry land.
characters.funFact: Noah's ark was about 135 metres long — longer than a football field!

characters.name: David
clues: I was a shepherd boy with a sling and five smooth stones.
I defeated a giant everyone else was afraid of.
I became the king of Israel.
characters.funFact: David wrote many of the Psalms — songs and prayers that people still pray today.

characters.name: Daniel
clues: I prayed three times a day, no matter what.
I was thrown into a den of hungry lions.
God sent an angel to shut the lions' mouths.
characters.funFact: Daniel served God faithfully from his youth right into old age.

characters.name: Esther
clues: I became queen of a great nation.
I was brave enough to speak up for my people.
I prayed and fasted before I went to see the king.
characters.funFact: Esther was chosen as queen for her beauty, but her courage saved a whole nation.

characters.name: Jonah
clues: I tried to run away from God on a boat.
I preached in the city of Nineveh.
characters.funFact: Jonah spent three days inside the fish before God gave him a second chance.

characters.name: Moses
clues: I was found in a basket floating on a river.
God spoke to me from a burning bush.
I led God's people out of Egypt.
characters.funFact: God used Moses' ordinary staff to do extraordinary miracles.
